{{Current events|year=2022|month=04|day=21|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Siege of Mariupol]]
*****[[Vladimir Putin]] tells [[Russian Ground Forces|his troops]] not to storm the [[Azovstal iron and steel works]] building in [[Mariupol]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], calling that plan "impractical" and instead ordering a blockade of the area. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/apr/21/russia-ukraine-war-latest-ukraine-offers-unconditional-talks-on-mariupol-as-west-warns-of-russian-cyber-attacks-live?page=with:block-6261192b8f088371a5f3f3e5#block-6261192b8f088371a5f3f3e5 (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
***[[2022 Mazar-i-Sharif mosque bombing]]
****Thirty-one people are killed and 87 others are injured in a bombing at a [[Shia Islam in Afghanistan|Shia]] [[mosque]] in [[Mazar-i-Sharif]], [[Balkh Province]]. The [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the bombing. [https://ca.news.yahoo.com/afghanistan-more-20-dead-injured-115333385.html (Yahoo! News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/blast-hits-shiite-mosque-northern-afghanistan-causing-multiple-casualties-2022-04-21/ (Reuters)]
**Four people are killed and 18 others are injured during a bombing in [[Kunduz]] targeting the [[217 Omari Corps]]. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-177678 (Tolo News)]
**Four [[Taliban]] members are killed and another is wounded when their vehicle is hit by a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] in [[Nangarhar Province]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-61174991 (BBC News)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Boko Haram]] raid the town of [[Geidam]], [[Yobe State]], [[Nigeria]], killing 12 people. Several buildings are destroyed, including a school. [https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/524958-boko-haram-insurgents-kill-12-in-yobe-burn-schools-staff-quarters.html (''The Premium Times'')] [https://www.thestar.com/news/world/africa/2022/04/21/suspected-extremist-attack-kills-9-in-northeastern-nigeria.html (''The Toronto Star'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Florida Legislature|legislature]] for the [[U.S. state]] of [[Florida]] votes to strip [[Walt Disney World]] of its ability to self-govern by dissolving the [[Reedy Creek Improvement District]], in apparent retaliation for [[Disney]]'s actions during and following the passage of [[Florida House Bill 1557|HB 1557]], also known as the "Don't Say Gay" bill. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/04/21/florida-set-to-dissolve-disneys-reedy-creek-special-district.html (CNBC)] [https://www.ft.com/content/b50f2f2e-591a-49bb-a4f3-ae2709c62440 (''Financial Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed after a fire occurs at a defence research institute in [[Tver]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/seven-killed-fire-russian-defence-research-institute-tass-2022-04-21/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Israel relations]]
**[[Government of Iran|Iran]] arrests three alleged Israeli [[Mossad]] spies in [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], claiming that the spies are part of recent sensitive data leaks. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-iran-israel-arrests-classified-information-b3915fcd39985702da3ef7bc6f1a987d (AP)]
*[[India–Maldives relations]]
**[[President of the Maldives|Maldivian President]] [[Ibrahim Mohamed Solih]] issues a presidential decree outlawing protests against [[India]], claiming it is causing national instability and putting the security of Indian diplomats at risk. [https://indianexpress.com/article/world/maldives-issues-decree-to-ban-anti-india-protests-7881122/ (''Indian Express'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Former [[President of Honduras|Honduran President]] [[Juan Orlando Hernández]] is extradited to the [[United States]] on drug trafficking charges. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/04/21/honduras-president-hernandez-extradited/ (''The Washington Post'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
